text_blocks.snippet: Common side effects of losartan include dizziness, upper respiratory infections, stuffy nose, fatigue, and back or joint pain.
snippet_highlighted_words: dizziness, upper respiratory infections, stuffy nose, fatigue, and back or joint pain

text_blocks.snippet: These symptoms are usually mild and often improve as your body adjusts to the medication:

list.snippet: Dizziness or lightheadedness (especially when standing up quickly)
Cold-like symptoms, stuffy nose, or sinus congestion
Back pain, leg pain, or muscle cramps
Mild digestive issues like diarrhea, nausea, or vomiting

text_blocks.snippet: Some reactions are uncommon but require medical attention:

list.snippet: High potassium levels (Hyperkalemia): Can cause muscle weakness, numbness, or an irregular heartbeat.
Kidney problems: May cause a dramatic decrease in urination, swelling in the legs, or unexpected weight gain.
Severe low blood pressure (Hypotension): Can lead to fainting, confusion, or severe, persistent dizziness.
Allergic reactions (Angioedema): Dangerous swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat, which makes it hard to breathe or swallow.
Pregnancy risk: Losartan can cause injury or harm to an unborn baby and should not be taken during pregnancy.

text_blocks.snippet: You can learn more about managing these risks on the NHS Losartan Guide or check detailed indications via MedlinePlus Losartan.
